Title: Persistent Token Validation — Revoked Token Returns 401 on xAPI
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
- Authorization__EnablePersistentStorageTokenValidation=true configured
- BACK_URL and STORE_ID accessible
- TECHFLOW_BUYER account available (separate from agent pool active sessions)
Steps:
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token for @td(TECHFLOW_BUYER.email) — obtain Token-A
[WAIT] Receive Token-A access_token + refresh_token
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token for same user — obtain Token-B (distinct authorization entry)
[WAIT] Receive Token-B
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/revocation token=<Token-A refresh_token> token_type_hint=refresh_token Authorization: Bearer <Token-A access_token>
[WAIT] Revocation returns HTTP 200
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/graphql Authorization: Bearer <Token-A access_token> body: {"query": "{ me { id } }"}
[WAIT] Response (expect HTTP 401)
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/graphql Authorization: Bearer <Token-B access_token> body: {"query": "{ me { id } }"}
[WAIT] Response (expect HTTP 200 — Token-B unaffected)
Assertions:
[STATUS] POST /connect/revocation returns HTTP 200
[STATUS] POST /graphql with revoked Token-A returns HTTP 401 — NOT 200 (persistent validation enforced)
[BODY] 401 response does not contain user data
[STATUS] POST /graphql with active Token-B returns HTTP 200
[BODY] Token-B response data.me.id is non-null
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] Token-A rejected on xAPI immediately after revocation (no request-level cache when EnablePersistentStorageTokenValidation=true)
[API] Token-B unaffected — scoped revocation
[NETWORK] No 5xx on any request
Failure_Signals: Token-A still returns 200 on xAPI after revocation (persistent validation not active — VCST-4576 regression); Token-B also rejected after Token-A revocation (over-broad); 500 on revocation endpoint
Cleanup: none — Token-A already revoked; Token-B cleanup on next session
